notes.title: Massive update "Surveillance Work -Taboo-"
notes.notes:
There are no plans to provide an English version at this time.
Support for the English version will depend on sales in Japan.

◆How to play the old version
You can play the old version by following these steps.
1. Select "Surveillance" from your Steam library.
2. Click the gear icon in the top right and select "Properties" at the bottom.
3. Select the "Beta" tab and select "Legacy - 旧バージョン" from the drop-down list in the top right.

notes.title: Major free update in March (Japanese Version Only）
notes.notes:
A major update is planned for March, but currently only Japanese will be implemented.

Also, since save data is not compatible before and after the update, the old version will be moved to a different branch.

You can play the old version by following the steps below.
1. Select "Surveillance Work" from your Steam library
2. Select "Manage" (the gear icon) in the upper right, and select "Properties" at the bottom
3. Select "legacy - 旧バージョン" from the drop-down list in the upper right

notes.title: Update on 2024/05/26
notes.notes:
１．Menu screen
①Add “Endings”
- You can view the ending you have reached again.
- You can check the hints for reaching the endings that you have not reached yet.

②Add “Anomalies”
- You can check the list of anomalies for each facility.
- You can check the explanation for reported anomalies.

③English versions of "Documents" and "Search" are currently being prepared.

２．Added new difficulty level
①Addition of difficulty level “Customize”
- Added "Customize" difficulty level that allows you to adjust the appearance probability of "Easy", "Medium", and "Difficult" anomalies (Story only)
- You can adjust the appearance probability using the gear button next to the "Customize" checkbox.

②Addition of “Wanted” difficulty level
- Among "Easy" and "Medium" anomalies, unreported anomalies will appear preferentially (Training only).
- If all "Easy" and "Medium" anomalies in the facility are reported, the difficulty level will be equivalent to "Safety".

notes.title: Update on 04/12/2024
notes.notes:
1. Added new anomalies
Each facility has over 200 anomalies.

2. Anomaly “Mischief”.
The anomaly "Light" has been merged into the anomaly "Mischief".
Therefore, the following characteristics have been added to the anomaly "Mischief".
- Lighting equipment turns on/off or flashes, candles go out.

notes.title: Update on 04/02/2024
notes.notes:
1. Abnormal Event
Special events "Abnormal Event" caused by anomalies has been added.
Please refer to the in-game manual for details.

2. Explanation of changes caused by anomalies
An information icon has been placed on the screen at the end of work.
Click this icon to see images and text about unreported anomalies.

3. Anomaly "Mischief"
Added the following characteristic to Anomaly "Mischief":
- Machines, except lighting fixtures, are put into operation.
- Objects are destroyed, repaired or graffitied.

notes.title: Fixed English translation（Update on 03/14/2024）
notes.notes:
1. Revised English translation
Revised English translation of the manual, text in the story, ending, etc.

2. Add new anomaly ”Resize”
- Added anomaly "Resize" to gradually change the size of an object. The anomaly "Resize" will now appear instead of the anomaly "Light".
- Before starting the Story and Training, you can change the anomaly "Light" to appear instead of the anomaly "Resize".

notes.title: Update on February 5, 2024
notes.notes:
1. Adjusting game difficulty
(1) Fixed so that "Initial Placement Unchanged" can be selected in Story mode.
     Please note that the initial value is unchecked (initial placement will change)
(2) Slightly reduced the upper limit on the number of difficult-to-discover anomalies ("Hard" anomalies)
      to appear on the "Default" difficulty level.
(3) Increased the amount of light emitted by the anomaly "light".
(4) Several corrections and deletions have been made regarding the anomaly "Suspicious".
      Added new anomalies as many as deleted ones.

2. About UI changes
(1) The selected “Initial Placement” has been clearly indicated on the pause screen during work.
(2) The initial value of the screen brightness was set a little higher.

3. others
In Story mode, anomalies related to ending branches have been fixed so that they are more likely to occur.

notes.title: Update on February 3, 2023
notes.notes:
・Fixed the ending branch on the second playthrough when playing the game continuously.
・Fixed some other minor bugs
